issue.title: bob tick: one ordered, configurable pass for Bob's frequent background work
issue.description: One `bob tick` command runs Bob's more-than-daily background work (gcal, gmail, gkeep, refs, projects, tasks) in a fixed order. Each step has its own cadence, set in chezmoi's Bob config. The Mac's four staggered cron jobs become one 5-minute `bob-tick` job. Automated `bob gcal sync` runs stay at least an hour apart, and the command's output, status board, and receipt explain what ran, what waited, and why.
